text: Citizens of countries jointly building the Belt and Road Initiative, non-Chinese citizens, holding valid foreign passports.Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.Have a high school diploma or above, with excellent academic performance, and generally be no older than 25 years old.Be friendly to China, have good conduct, abide by laws and regulations, have no record of violating school rules and regulations, no public security penalties, and no criminal records. 5. The score of the Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK) must reach 180 or above at levelApplicants whose native language is Chinese or who studied in Chinese during their previous academic stage may submit relevant proof.
